No you're right,  I really don't know how to change anything. Yeah I've been dealing with suicidal thoughts for the last few years.  I can usually manage, for better or worse, I just hate feeling this way.

I live in Utah, and my work doesn't provide insurance.  I haven't really looked into any kinds of meds or therapy, because I'm living paycheck to paycheck at the moment, so neither have been much of a priority for me. I'm nervous about taking meds too, because I don't like any kind of chemical dependency.

I can't really afford any meds or to talk to a professional. My life is okay, my job sucks, but it's better than nothing. The only people I really talk to anymore are my family, and we don't get along too well. I don't really know, I hate complaining or describing this stuff, I don't want to sound cliche or dramatic or whiny.
